cases.summary: Pay Button request failed Please fix following errors: The Currency field is required.
cases.description: **Issue:** When creating a payment button the currency field appears not to be passing along. **Steps to reproduce:** 1. Go to Payments > Pay button 2. Fill out the following details: - Price - Currency - Checkout Description - Order ID 3. Click on the preview button or the alternative link 4. See error

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix pay button type comparison

Fixes #3396. We need to compare the button type value loosely, because initially the type is an integer and after it gets set by Vue it is a string.
